title: Why Fast Fashion Is Bad for You and the Environment (and What You Can Do)
seoTitle: Why Fast Fashion Is Bad for You and the Environment
seoDescription: Why fast fashion is bad for you, garment workers and the planet, with UN figures on textile waste and emissions, plus simple ways to buy less and better.
excerpt: Fast fashion's cheap, trendy clothes cost more than they seem: poor quality, possible skin irritation, low-paid factory work, 92 million tonnes of textile waste a year and up to 8% of global emissions, per the UN. Here's why, and simple ways to cut back.
